coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: New Law on Oil (Zakon o nafti) adopted Dec 2025 together with the Gas law and the Law on mandatory reserves; the paragraf.rs summary does not state retailer duties. Price-cap decree (Sl. glasnik 54/2026) with fines of 100,000-2,000,000 RSD and up to 1 year activity ban; subsidised farm diesel at 184 RSD via registered-holding cards, which private pumps say they cannot honour. No retailer register or e-reporting duty confirmed. Retail-specific duties in the new law are unverified.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: One search returned only Croatian warehouse-receipt law (skladišnica) and a Kosovo ministry document. Nothing Serbian confirmed on public grain warehouses, so Serbian licensing and reporting is unchecked. Nothing new beyond K05 for fruit.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Serbian Law on Cooperatives (Sl. glasnik 112/2015) includes cooperative audit (zadružna revizija); no 2025-26 amendment found. Audit practice and costs are unchecked. Weak candidate listed.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Pravilnik on e-karton (Sl. glasnik 45/2025) applies from 1 Jan 2026 and covers private practices: patient identification data from the practice software must go to the e-karton, with a 24-hour update rule. RFZO contracts with private clinics are by service category (IVF, cataract, etc.) via public calls. No e-invoicing or billing duty specific to clinics found.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Law on psychoactive controlled substances (Sl. glasnik 99/2010, 57/2018); substance list updated by Pravilnik Sl. glasnik 58/2024. No source found for pharmacy or precursor record/report formats or deadlines. Unverified candidate listed.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Private security: licences valid 5 years, renewal application opens 60 days before expiry at the police administration of residence; about 45,000 licences issued, 1,720 registered legal entities (Novosti, 31 Jul 2021). Draft amendments to the Law on Private Security exist, but their adoption is unconfirmed. Cleaning and manpower agencies were not searched.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: One search returned only Croatian and Montenegrin construction-diary rules and a 2015 Serbian e-permit article. No Serbian construction-diary or site-register duty confirmed. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: AML Law obligors include real-estate brokers and notaries (when working on property deals). Reports of cash transactions of EUR 15,000 or more and of suspicious transactions go to the Administration for the Prevention of Money Laundering. Dec 2024 amendments ban cash payments of EUR 10,000 or more. A 2024 national risk assessment flags real estate and brokerage. A proposal to amend the Law on Brokerage in Real Estate Sales and Lease was found but its content was not read.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: eTurista (free state central system) is mandatory for all accommodation, including uncategorised objects, from Oct 2020 per biznis.rs. Local governments register and categorise household accommodation. Flat-rate tourist tax per bed per year, set in 2019: 1,000 to 3,300 RSD; fines for unregistered letting 150,000-350,000 RSD. The Ministry (2025) demands registration numbers on platform listings; its dispute with Booking was unresolved. No new 2026 Serbian rule found.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Only an old Serbian decree on a register of fruit and vegetable exporters to Russia (cold store of at least 500 t fruit or 200 t vegetables, 15-day change notices; date and status unclear). Nothing on eFito, EUDR or CBAM beyond K03. Not enough found.

coverage.category: 31. Wine growers and cellars (vineyard register, wine register, annual declarations)
coverage.found: The Serbian rules (via a search snippet, not an official page) say growers with more than 10 ari must enter the vineyard register, and the annual production declaration is due by 31 Dec. The minpolj.gov.rs page returned 503, so forms and portal are unverified.

coverage.category: 32. Packaging and packaging-waste obligors (producers, importers, packers)
coverage.found: The 2009 Law on Packaging and Packaging Waste and a register-keeping rulebook were found. No data on current thresholds, small-firm exemptions, annual reports or 2026 changes.

coverage.category: 33. Retail fiscalisation and e-fiscalisation changes (small shops, caterers)
coverage.found: The search returned only the Croatian fiscalisation law; nothing Serbian was found and no budget was left to retry.

coverage.category: 34. Excise goods traders (tobacco, alcohol, fuel excise warehouses)
coverage.found: The one search was rejected by the tool because of a domain filter and returned no results; no budget was left to retry.

coverage.category: 35. Registered farm holdings (RPG) and subsidy-linked duties
coverage.found: The 2026 farm-diesel scheme links 184 RSD diesel to registered holdings (area registered by 24 Jan 2026) via cards. Private pumps report they cannot sell at that price. Holding-side duties were not examined.

coverage.category: 36. Employers using e-Bolovanje (sick-leave reimbursement)
coverage.found: Law on e-Bolovanje-poslodavac applies from 1 Jan 2026; from 1 Apr 2026 employers can file wage-compensation claims electronically. Nothing new beyond K02 and K07.
